title: fix(agents): Claude CLI turns hit the 20,000-line limit when Claude Code adds stream frame metadata
body:
Related: #185404, #153545, #166127, #159930

## What Problem This Solves

Long tool-heavy `claude-cli` turns on current Claude Code (seen on 2.1.296 and 2.1.310) fail with `CLI JSONL output exceeded 20000 lines`, because every streamed token frame is charged as a full ordinary record again. The same overcharge pushes long production turns past the 8 MiB budget (`exceeded 8388608 characters`); that part is estimated from session transcripts below, not reproduced.

## User Impact

Agents on the `claude-cli` backend can again finish long turns with many tool calls and streamed tool input on current Claude Code instead of stopping at the 20,000-line limit. Text, tool-input and nonempty thinking frames again cost their payload plus 32 characters of the 8 MiB budget instead of their full envelope; empty thinking progress frames and `signature_delta` frames stay fully charged, as before. The limits stay as they are, and no setting is added.

## Why This Change Was Made

#153545 charges a recognized partial-message frame (`stream_event` / `content_block_delta` with a text, thinking or tool-input delta) for its payload plus a fixed 32 characters, and keeps the 20,000-line limit for ordinary records only. It recognizes a frame only when every top-level key is known. Current Claude Code (seen on 2.1.296 and 2.1.310) attaches two extra fields to these frames: `api_message_id` on every `stream_event`, and the display setting `thinking_display` (`"updates"`) on thinking frames. No frame matches any more, so each 12 to 16 character delta is charged its full envelope of about 300 characters and counts as an ordinary line, which is the accounting #153545 replaced.

This change accepts the two fields as bounded frame metadata beside `uuid`, `session_id` and `parent_tool_use_id`: `api_message_id` as a string of at most 64 characters on any recognized delta (captured ids are 28), and `thinking_display` as a string of at most 32 characters on `thinking_delta` frames only, the only delta type that carries it in the captures below. Accepting it only there keeps the recognized shape to what Claude Code sends; any other placement keeps full accounting, like any other unrecognized frame. OpenClaw reads neither field: the parser takes message ids from `message_start` (`src/agents/cli-output-stream.ts:521`, `src/agents/cli-output-events.ts:449`), and no other tracked file mentions either name (search under Evidence).

Unknown keys, non-string or oversized metadata, `thinking_display` on other delta types, and empty deltas keep full accounting as before, and outer padding is still charged on top of a discounted frame. The per-line cap, the 20,000 ordinary-line limit, the 8 MiB budget and the per-frame charge are unchanged. As with the existing `uuid`, `session_id` and `parent_tool_use_id` fields, metadata values are not charged: the caps now allow up to 480 characters of values per recognized frame instead of 384, so a flood of maximal frames can pass more raw bytes through the parser than the budget counts while still stopping at 233,016 frames.

This PR repairs the accounting; #185404 proposes operator overrides for the same budgets. #166127 (tool-result payloads) and #159930 (Edit/Write file echoes) discount other record types and compose with this change.

## Evidence

The shipped-entry-point run below reproduces the 20,000-line failure on this PR's base and completes with this change. The 8 MiB failures are covered by the production table further down, which is rebuilt from session transcripts and therefore an estimate. Each build ran once, and the model run is nondeterministic.

**Current frame shape.** A redacted `text_delta` frame from Claude Code 2.1.296 (local capture), and an empty thinking progress frame and a nonempty `thinking_delta` frame from 2.1.310 (gateway log). Redaction mapped ids to deterministic fakes and text to filler of the same length.


`api_message_id` is on every `stream_event` record in both captures (2,441 of 2,441 on 2.1.296, 35,432 of 35,432 on 2.1.310). Among delta frames, `thinking_display` appears only on `thinking_delta`, and on every one (24 of 24 on 2.1.296, 1,427 of 1,427 on 2.1.310, of which 21 carry thinking text and are discounted by this change; empty progress frames keep full accounting); elsewhere it is on `message_start`, `content_block_start` and `assistant` records, which never qualify for the discount.

Outside the two changed files, no tracked file mentions either field:

```
$ git grep -n -e api_message_id -e thinking_display -- . ':!src/agents/cli-output-stream-limits.ts' ':!src/agents/cli-output-partial-messages.test.ts'
$ echo $?
1
```

**Shipped entry point, before and after.** One `openclaw agent exec` turn through the bundled `claude-cli` backend, built from this PR's base (`83274dfe321`) and from this branch's head (tree `84fff5923b7`, which identifies the head independent of commit signing). Claude Code 2.1.296, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `--thinking medium`, Node 24, macOS. Each run had its own temporary `OPENCLAW_HOME` and this config:

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": "anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5",
      "models": { "anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5": { "agentRuntime": { "id": "claude-cli" } } },
      "timeoutSeconds": 1800
    }
  }
}
```

Prompt: write `part01.txt` to `part16.txt` (300 lines each) with the `write` tool, run `head -c 4000 partNN.txt` with `exec` after each, then reply `DONE`. The tool input streams as about 30,000 small `input_json_delta` frames, the same shape as the failing production turns below.

| this change | 0 | `ok` | 32, 0 failures | 16 (`part01.txt` to `part16.txt`), 4,800 lines |

Redaction replaced run and session ids and hashes, and dropped two skill-loading lines from each stderr.

**Charge breakdown on real records.** Each line (plus its newline) was fed through `chargeClaudeStreamJsonLine` from `main` and from this change, with #166127's `measureClaudeToolResultMessage` and #159930's normalizer composed in the order #166127 uses. Redaction kept every line at its original length. The totals and ordinary-line counts for this change (the 2.1.296 turn, the 2.1.310 records and all four production turns) were re-measured with the code at this head and match.

- 41,071 real stream-json records from Claude Code 2.1.310 (694 completed gateway turns, logged with `OPENCLAW_CLI_BACKEND_LOG_OUTPUT`): `main` discounts none of the partial frames. With this change `text_delta` goes from 7,320,100 to 1,218,600 charged characters and `input_json_delta` from 1,249,728 to 207,720 (both 83% lower). Ordinary lines drop from 41,071 to 12,697.
- One complete real turn from Claude Code 2.1.296 (Haiku, thinking, 8 tool calls, 2,494 records): 1,093,169 charged characters on `main`, 469,353 with this change (57% lower). Ordinary lines drop from 2,494 to 130.

**Production failures (estimated).** Four `claude-cli` turns (41 to 73 minutes, 283 to 448 MCP tool calls each, thinking on) failed in one evening with `exceeded 8388608 characters`. The gateway does not log the stream of a failed turn, so each stream was rebuilt from that run's Claude Code session transcript: payloads from the transcript, envelopes copied from real 2.1.310 records, deltas split at the frame sizes measured above. These rows are estimates, not captured streams.

**Tests and checks** (macOS, Node 24, at this commit):

- `src/agents/cli-output-partial-messages.test.ts`: 39 passed. New cases cover current text, tool-input and thinking frames with `api_message_id` and `thinking_display`, and with both set to `null` (exact charge, and 20,001 frames completing); the captured 2.1.296 text frame and 2.1.310 nonempty thinking frame (charged 35 and 62 characters) and the captured empty thinking progress frame (full charge); each field exactly at its cap; full accounting for an `api_message_id` of 65 characters or a non-string one, a `thinking_display` of 33 characters or a non-string one, `thinking_display` on a text or tool-input frame, and an unknown record key; and floods of one-character text frames with typical and maximal metadata and of thinking frames with maximal metadata, which still fail with `exceeded 8388608 characters` at frame 233,017 (under 1 second each).
- With only the production change reverted, 19 tests fail and 20 pass. Ten mutations each fail at least one test: raising either cap, lowering either cap by one, dropping the string check, accepting any record key, removing either field, dropping the `thinking_delta` scope check, and setting the fixed per-frame charge to 0.
- All 10 `src/agents/cli-output-*.test.ts` files: 233 passed. `src/agents/cli-runner/`: 73 files, 843 passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core`, `pnpm tsgo:core:test`, oxlint and `oxfmt --check` on the touched files pass.
- `pnpm check:changed`: every step passes except the dead-export scan, which reports 14 unused exports in `extensions/qa-lab`, `src/gateway`, `src/agents/main-session-recovery`, `test/plugins` and `ui`, none of them touched here. `pnpm deadcode:exports` on the base commit without this change reports the same 14 entries. With that step skipped (`OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_SKIP_DEADCODE=1`), `pnpm check:changed` exits 0.
- No changelog entry: `CONTRIBUTING.md` reserves `CHANGELOG.md` for release generation. `docs/gateway/cli-backends.md` already describes the discount for recognized partial-message envelopes, which this change restores, so it needs no edit.


## Independent real-Claude Gateway verification

https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186085#issuecomment-6448026202 — official Claude Code2.1.310 with a local Messages fixture: built Gateway main fails at20,000 lines twice, candidate completes exact20,118-character final replies twice, short controls pass. Native metadata shape is separately captured and its observability limits disclosed. The test-only follow-up consolidates the three redundant flood variants;79 focused tests and scoped formatting/lint pass.


## Current test-budget repair

https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186085#issuecomment-6448658229 — repaired head9f78626eb45f941c3435e492ee59feda80e3120e preserves every distinct parser-budget guard in table rows, consolidates only the same owner's framing scaffolding, and reduces the whole-PR test delta to **-5**. **81 focused tests** and scoped formatting/lint pass. Production and the real Claude CLI proof are unchanged. The earlier test-line CI failure is explicitly superseded, pending repaired-head gates.
